sentences.en: With the properties of avoiding deliquescence and crystallization, the whole sugar powder can be applied extensively in food industry instead of part of cane sugar or starch syrup.

sentences.en: The experiment of recirculation fumigation and natural deliquescence of dichlorvos and aluminium phosphide mixed with grain powder is introduced.

sentences.en: The corn protein foam powder was prepared by using corn gluten powder as the main material through the deliquescence of amylase, hydrolysis, discolor, deodorizing and drying.
sentences.vi: Bột bọt protein ngô được chế biến bằng cách sử dụng bột gluten ngô làm nguyên liệu chính thông qua quá trình tạo amylase, thủy phân, khử màu, khử mùi và làm khô.
